Select the first 500 exact activity measurements for compounds tested against thyroid hormone receptor CHEMBL1862. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1862 and require exact measurements (standard_relation = '='). Require compound structures by joining compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Sort rows by potency (standard_value ascending) and limit to 500 rows. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows.
